Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5604063. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5604063 and require canonical_smiles to be available. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
